description: Aspect ratio helper. In 'simplify' mode, give width and height to get the simplified W:H ratio, decimal ratio and nearest common ratio. In 'solve' mode, give a ratio (ratioW:ratioH) plus one of width or height to get the missing side. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/aspect-ratio-calculator/

height.description: Height in pixels or units (simplify mode, or the known side in solve mode)

mode.description: 'simplify' a width and height, or 'solve' a missing side from a ratio

width.description: Width in pixels or units (simplify mode, or the known side in solve mode)
